mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the UNRATE series above 6.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting labor cost pressures that reduce corporate profitability.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in UNRATE-up periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises AND UNRATE falls simultaneously, signaling simultaneous monetary tightening and labor market weakening, this combination triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to recession risk anticipation.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% AND UNRATE falls > 0.2% in 3 months
regime_hint: simultaneous monetary tightening and labor contraction
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, or p > 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion phase, where GDPC1 growth slows despite high activity, investors anticipate peak and buy ahead of potential declines, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle demand expansions, 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When demand (GDPC1) outpaces supply (INDPRO), creating a demand-supply imbalance, this signals potential inflationary pressures, prompting investors to seek higher yields and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 / INDPRO ratio exceeds 1.2 in 3 months
failure_condition: GDPC1/INDPRO ratio crosses above 1.2 without positive 20-day returns, or p > 0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery phase, characterized by low federal funds rates and rising demand indicators, this combination signals economic revival, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% AND GDPC1 growth > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery phases, 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the PAYEMS series above 1.2 million in 3 months signals strong labor market growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors bet on continued economic expansion.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses threshold without positive 5-day returns, or p > 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate remains low (below 2%) alongside weak supply growth (INDPRO below trend), this combination creates a demand-driven rally, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <2% and INDPRO <102 without positive 20-day returns, or p > 0.05 in such instances.
